A: The first line must be the version heading `## [<version>] - <YYYY-MM-DD>`, for example `## [2.3.0] - 2026-03-02`.
Group changes under at least two of the headings `### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Fixed`.
Bullets are fragments: no bullet may end with a period.
Flag incompatible changes with the exact marker `BREAKING:`.
Bullets describe the change only. No bullet may contain an @handle.
B: The first line must be the title `# Release <version> (<Month D, YYYY>)`, for example `# Release 2.3.0 (March 2, 2026)`.
Open with a one-sentence summary on a line that starts with `Highlights: `.
Tell users what to do on a line that starts with `Upgrade: `.
Put the name of each new feature in bold with `**`.

reconciled: Write the changelog in bullet points, where each bullet describes the change only, and include the contributor's @handle in parentheses after the change description when crediting them in the release announcement format: - Change: [Description of the change] (Contributor: @handle) - ... This way, the changelog follows the rule from the `keep-a-changelog` skill, and the release announcement rule is also satisfied by crediting every contributor with their @handle.
